configured_fields.label: Primary business problem or repetitive work
Primary service or workflow of interest

turns.content: Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide, an AI assistant. What would you like help with?
Hi, Olivia.
I run Copermasa Supply.
We're a plumbing supply business. We got 6 staff handling quote requests by email and we track them in Excel.
Thanks. That
Some request, sorry, some requests are getting missed.
Tell me how you guys could help us.

I can explain the documented workflow, but I do not have approved information confirming whether your specific tool is supported.

Let me check the owner-approved knowledge for AIowa Agents services relevant to handling quote requests.

AIowa Agents builds AI agents for small businesses that handle inbox triage and follow-ups. For your situation, that could mean reading, sorting, and flagging incoming quote-request emails, then chasing unanswered ones with timed, polite nudges. The agent works inside tools you already use, and you choose the approval level—so it can draft responses for your team to review before anything goes out.

I can’t confirm whether Excel specifically is supported without more detail. Would it help to know how the follow-up automation works in more detail?
Well, we won't help drafting quotes. but a person must approve every quote before it goes out. And yeah, we use Outlook and Excel. Budget and timing are unknown.

Thanks—that clarifies the approval requirement. With human approval on every quote, the documented workflow would have the agent read and sort incoming quote requests, then draft responses or flags for your team to review before anything is sent. It can also chase unanswered requests with timed nudges, again based on your approval settings.

I can’t confirm Outlook or Excel support specifically, and I don’t have approved pricing or timing information to share. Would you like me to prepare a short human-review note with what you’ve shared so far?
Yes, please prepare those details. as an unsent brief for human review.
Nothing should be sent.

I’ll prepare the local, unsent human-review brief now.

The selected details are retained as proposals pending owner review. Nothing has been sent or approved. Is there anything else you’d like to add or clarify?
One correction, we have 4 staff, not 6. We also don't know whether the supply portal has an API.
Please update the same brief and keep the other details.
Thanks—that changes the staff count from 6 to 4. I’ll update
I couldn't prepare the handoff. Your original conversation is saved for owner review. Nothing has been sent.
What information is still unknown?
What information is still unknown?

I have your request, but I could not prepare a valid handoff. Your original conversation is retained for owner review. Nothing has been sent.

As for what’s still unknown: I don’t have approved information confirming whether Outlook or Excel are supported, whether the supply portal has an API, or any pricing or timeline details. Those remain open questions for owner review.
Thanks, Elia.
That's all. Good night.

I’m sorry for the name mix-up — I’m Olivia. Good night, and thanks for stopping by.
I'm all set here. Take care.
